# elemento_spotvm (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Elemento spot vm on the cloud selected by `target`. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.

### Read-Only

- `auth` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period.
- `cloudinit_b64` (String) Base64-encoded cloud-init file.
- `cpu` (Attributes) CPU requirements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu))
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `mem` (Attributes) Memory requirements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mem))
- `networks` (Attributes List) Network interfaces of the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
- `os` (Attributes) Operating system requirements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--os))
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
- `storage` (Attributes) Storage requirements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags attached to the VM.
- `vm_name` (String) Name of the VM.
